sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Axios' Barak Ravid drops another "U.S.-Iran 60-day MoU awaiting Trump's final approval" headline: SPY immediately jumps 3 points to ~754, QQQ/Nasdaq hit new highs.
  • However, i24 News reports almost simultaneously that Khamenei has not accepted any MOU, and Trump himself states he "needs a few days to consider"—the market ignores this and continues to rise.
  • April PCE data, which came in hot, is completely ignored; core inflation pressure is skipped over by algorithms.
  • DELL continues its rally pre-market due to a large Pentagon contract; today's after-hours earnings are the key catalyst (options implied ±11%).
  • AMD hits an all-time high of $510 during the session, market cap ~$817B; the community is already calling for "$1T within two weeks."
  • MU tests the $1000 psychological level repeatedly in the $947-985 range; DA Davidson PT mentions $1500.
  • Memory chip stocks surge collectively: SNDK/WDC/STX hit new highs simultaneously.
  • ORCL finally breaks $200, CRSR surges +50% in the morning before pulling back to around +17%.
  • NVDA / META / NFLX / UBER all in the red—the "lonely victims" in a market hitting new highs.

整体气氛：极度的狂热与彻底的自嘲混合在一起。 WSB很少承认市场“完全脱离现实”，但每个人都在追逐反弹。贪婪指数估计为 85-90 ，但与典型的狂热不同，社区有强烈的自我意识，“我们都知道这是假的”，创造了一种“清醒的狂热”——这种结构经常在拐点附近出现。

社区情绪与实际趋势：高度一致——每个人都在嘲笑 Axios，同时购买 0DTE 通话。 “阅读新闻=赔钱/阅读真相和Axios=利润”已成为本周的元数据。
